FISHING LICENCE · ZAMBIA

Zambia fishing licence

The official licence registry lists a monthly recreational permit for non-residents. A lodge's institutional angling permit is a separate category; confirm whether your trip includes personal permission.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Non-residents who apply for recreational fishing permission.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident recreational permitnon resident1 monthZMW 840

Extra stamps and permits

  • Institutional angling permit
    A separate permit category for lodges, camps and hotels.

How to buy

Contact the Department of Fisheries at the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Zambia?

The official licence registry lists a monthly recreational permit for non-residents. A lodge's institutional angling permit is a separate category; confirm whether your trip includes personal permission.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Zambia?

Non-resident recreational permit: ZMW 840 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Zambia?

Contact the Department of Fisheries at the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock.
